title: State Sanskrit Academy Declamation Championship
description: Sri K. Raghavan, a final-year B.A. O.L. Sanskrit student, secured the 1st prize at the State Sanskrit Academy Declamation Championship, competing against candidates from 45 institutions.

title: 100% Pass Percentage in Sanskrit Honours
description: The Department of Sanskrit achieved a perfect 100% pass rate in the final semester examinations, with 12 students securing distinction grades.

title: National Seminar on 'Ancient Indian Heritage & Modern Science'
description: Matrusri Oriental College successfully hosted a two-day national seminar funded by the ICPR, drawing over 150 scholars who presented research papers linking traditional oriental knowledge with modern science.

title: NAAC 'B++' Grade Accreditation
description: In the recent cycle of National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) evaluations, the college was awarded a 'B++' grade, recognizing its excellence in value-based education and community outreach.

title: Inter-University Telugu Literature Quiz Winners
description: A team of three B.A. O.L. Telugu students won the Gold Trophy at the South Zone Inter-University Telugu Quiz Competition, held in Vijayawada.

title: DST-Sponsored Computer Science Lab Extension
description: The College inaugurated a newly expanded Computer Science and ICT laboratory with high-speed internet and modern computing systems to support B.Sc. Honours (Computer Science) students.

title: Gold Medal in University Sanskrit Prathama Examinations
description: Kumari M. Gayatri of second-year B.A. Sanskrit was awarded the University Gold Medal for securing the highest aggregate score in the state-wide Sanskrit examinations.

title: Best Oriental College Excellence Award 2024
description: The college received the 'Best Oriental College Excellence Award' from the State Education Department for its outstanding service in preserving and teaching ancient Sanskrit and Telugu scriptures.

title: Launch of Add-On Course in 'Web Design & Computational Linguistics'
description: Successfully launched a modern 6-month Add-on certificate course merging Sanskrit grammar rules with Natural Language Processing (NLP) foundations, enrolling 35 students.

title: First Rank in District Sports Athletic Meet
description: G. Venkatesh of final year Telugu studies won 1st place in the 800-meter track event and 2nd place in the long jump at the District-level College Athletic Meet.

title: Faculty Research Publication Milestone
description: Dr. P. Sastri, HOD of Sanskrit, published a pioneering research book titled 'Pāṇini’s Aṣṭādhyāyī and Modern Coding Grammar', which was widely acclaimed by the linguistics community.
